findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/RootsOfUnity/Basic.lean:77` has `@[simp] theorem rootsOfUnity_one ... : rootsOfUnity 1 M = ⊥`; `:111` has `instance : Subsingleton (rootsOfUnity 1 M)`.

findings.fix: After deriving `Unique` for the source from `(pointsMulEquiv 1).injective.unique`, define the equivalence with `MulEquiv.ofUnique` and prove any desired simp lemmas from uniqueness.

summary: The PR duplicates existing Mathlib roots-of-unity API and hand-builds a one-element multiplicative equivalence instead of using the generic library combinator.
